home.showcaseSubtext: Click a dish to uncover its history
home.fact1Text: "Manok Pansoh" is a traditional Iban delicacy where chicken is cooked inside freshly cut bamboo over an open fire, sealing in moisture and flavor.
home.fact2Text: "Umai" is a traditional Melanau dish of raw sliced fish marinated with limau kasturi, onions, and chilies — Sarawak's ancient answer to ceviche.
home.fact3Text: The red color in traditional Kuching Kolo Mee often comes from 'Char Siu' oil, giving it a distinct savory sweetness compared to the white version.
home.fact4Text: "Gula Apong" is a natural palm sugar made from the Nipah palm found in Sarawak's coastal areas. It has a unique caramel-salty flavor profile.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.s1Text: Welcome to SarawakEats. We are committed to protecting your personal data and respecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your information when you use our platform. By registering an account and agreeing to this policy, you consent to the practices described here in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Act 2010 (PDPA) of Malaysia.
privacyPolicy.s2Text1: SarawakEats is a food and nutrition knowledge hub dedicated to preserving and promoting the traditional food heritage of the Bidayuh community in Sarawak, Malaysia. The platform is developed in collaboration with the Dayak Bidayuh Literary Society (DBLS).
privacyPolicy.s2Text2: For any privacy-related enquiries, please contact us at:
privacyPolicy.s3Text1: We collect the following personal data when you use SarawakEats:
privacyPolicy.s3Text2:
• Account information — your first name, last name, and email address when you register
• Authentication data — your password (stored in encrypted form) or your Google account identity if you sign in using Google SSO
• Profile information — your profile picture, bio, and location if you choose to provide them
• Preferences — your dietary preferences and allergy information
• User-generated content — recipes, community posts, and saved foods that you submit or save on the platform
• Device location — we may request access to your device's location to provide nearby restaurant recommendations. This is used solely for that purpose and is not stored on our servers
• Usage data — your last login date and account status
privacyPolicy.s4Text1: We use your personal data for the following purposes:
privacyPolicy.s4Text2:
• To create and manage your account
• To provide personalised features such as dietary recommendations and saved foods
• To allow you to contribute recipes and community posts to the platform
• To suggest nearby restaurants based on your location (if permission is granted)
• To send verification and notification emails related to your account
• To maintain the security and integrity of the platform
• To comply with legal obligations under Malaysian law
privacyPolicy.s5Title: 5. How We Store and Protect Your Data
privacyPolicy.s5Text1: We take the security of your personal data seriously. The following measures are in place to protect your information:
privacyPolicy.s5Text2:
• Passwords are encrypted using industry-standard hashing before storage
• All sessions are secured using encrypted cookies
• The platform implements CSRF protection and rate limiting to prevent unauthorised access
• Media files such as profile pictures are stored securely through Cloudinary
• All data transmissions between your browser and our servers are protected using HTTPS
privacyPolicy.s6Text1: To operate SarawakEats, we use the following third-party services that may process your data:
privacyPolicy.s6Text2:
• Authentication — Firebase (Google) for account verification and Google SSO
• Media storage — Cloudinary for profile pictures and uploaded images
• Backend hosting — Railway for server and database hosting
• Frontend hosting — Vercel for the web application
• Email delivery — Brevo for sending verification and notification emails
• AI services — OpenAI for the nutrition analyser feature
• Domain — Namecheap for domain management
privacyPolicy.s6Text3: Each of these services has their own privacy policies and data handling practices. We only share the minimum data necessary for these services to function.
privacyPolicy.s7Text1: We retain your personal data for as long as your account remains active. Accounts that have been inactive for 2 years will be automatically deleted. You will receive a warning email 30 days before deletion to give you the opportunity to log in and keep your account. If you choose to delete your account manually, your personal data will be removed from our systems, including your profile information, saved foods, and contributions. Some data may be retained for a short period for legal or administrative purposes.
privacyPolicy.s7Text2: In-app notifications are automatically deleted after 30 days of creation.
privacyPolicy.s8Text1: Under the Personal Data Protection Act 2010 (PDPA) of Malaysia, you have the right to:
privacyPolicy.s8Text2:
• Access your personal data that we hold
• Correct any inaccurate or incomplete personal data
• Withdraw consent for the processing of your personal data
• Request deletion of your account and associated data through your profile settings
privacyPolicy.s8Text3: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at info@sarawakeats.com.
privacyPolicy.s9Text: SarawakEats is intended for users aged 13 and above. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under the age of 13. If you believe a child under 13 has provided us with personal data, please contact us and we will take steps to remove that information.
privacyPolicy.s10Text: We reserve the right to update this Privacy Policy at any time. When significant changes are made, you will be prompted to review and accept the updated policy upon your next login. Continued use of the platform after accepting the updated policy constitutes your agreement to the changes.
privacyPolicy.s11Text1: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your personal data, please contact us at:

termsAndConditions.title: Terms & Conditions
termsAndConditions.s1Text: Welcome to SarawakEats. By accessing or using our platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, please do not use our platform. These terms apply to all users of SarawakEats, including guests, registered members, and administrators.
termsAndConditions.s2Text: You must be at least 13 years old to register an account on SarawakEats. By creating an account, you confirm that you meet this age requirement. If you are under 13, please do not register or submit any personal information.
termsAndConditions.s3Text:
• You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities that occur under your account
• You must provide accurate and truthful information when registering
• You must notify us immediately if you suspect any unauthorised access to your account
• We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms & Conditions
termsAndConditions.s4Text1: SarawakEats allows users to submit recipes, community posts, and participate in food discussions. By submitting content, you agree to the following:
termsAndConditions.s4Text2:
• Your content must be accurate, respectful, and culturally appropriate
• Your content must not be illegal, offensive, defamatory, or infringing on any intellectual property rights
• Your content must not contain spam, advertisements, or misleading information
• All submitted content is subject to review and approval by our administrators before being published
• We reserve the right to reject, edit, or remove any content that does not meet our guidelines
termsAndConditions.s5Text:
• The overall design, branding, and content of SarawakEats are owned by us
• User-submitted recipes and posts remain the intellectual property of the original creator
• By submitting content to SarawakEats, you grant us a non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to display, share, and promote your content on our platform for the purpose of cultural preservation
• You must not copy, reproduce, or distribute content from SarawakEats without prior permission
termsAndConditions.s6Text1: SarawakEats is dedicated to preserving the traditional food heritage of the Bidayuh community and other indigenous communities in Sarawak. All users are expected to:
termsAndConditions.s6Text2:
• Treat all cultural content with respect and sensitivity
• Not misrepresent, trivialise, or commercialise traditional knowledge shared on the platform
• Acknowledge the cultural origins of traditional recipes and stories
termsAndConditions.s7Text: The nutritional information and AI-generated recommendations provided on SarawakEats are for general informational and educational purposes only. We do not guarantee the absolute accuracy of any nutritional data. You should always consult a qualified healthcare or nutrition professional for specific dietary advice, especially if you have health conditions or allergies.
termsAndConditions.s8Text: The restaurant recommendations provided through our map feature may be based on a combination of our own curated restaurant data and third-party map services. Your device location may be used to suggest nearby restaurants. We do not guarantee the accuracy, availability, or quality of any recommended restaurant, as details such as opening hours and pricing may change over time. Location data used for this feature is not stored on our servers.
termsAndConditions.s9Text1: We reserve the right to suspend or permanently terminate your account if you:
termsAndConditions.s9Text2:
• Violate any part of these Terms & Conditions
• Submit false, misleading, or harmful content
• Engage in any behaviour that disrupts or harms the platform or its community
• Have an account that has been inactive for 2 years (a warning email will be sent 30 days prior to deletion)
termsAndConditions.s10Text: SarawakEats is provided on an "as is" basis. To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any direct, indirect, or consequential damages arising from your use of the platform, including but not limited to reliance on nutritional information, restaurant recommendations, or user-generated content.
termsAndConditions.s11Text: We reserve the right to modify these Terms & Conditions at any time. When significant changes are made, you will be prompted to review and accept the updated terms upon your next login. Continued use of the platform after accepting the updated terms constitutes your agreement to the changes.
